Name: Taiga Aisaka in Stardew
Author: ApollyonSV
Description:
[b]This is a mod that will change Penny in to Taiga Aisaka from Toradora![/b] I created this mod for a group and have decided to release it to you all as well. Why Penny? Well...it's just who I decided to make it that way. I may create some more Portrait mods in the future when time will allow!

[u][size=4]Installation:
[/size][/u]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url]﻿ if you don't have it already
Download the Taiga Aisaka in SDV mod.
Unpack the contents of the archive to your .../StardewValley/Mods folder
Launch the game and enjoy!

[u][size=4]Features:
[/size][/u]Custom portraits and sprites for all of the following:
Spring
Summer
Fall
Winter
Beach

[b]PS...I am by no means an artist. I have only recently just started practicing pixel art. But with that aside, I hope you like it!!![/b]
